name: K-Buffer Isosurface Extraction
definition: A framework for isosurface extraction that uses a 2D lookup table for the isosurface instead of the 3D pre-integrated volume integral table used for volume rendering.
summary: K-Buffer Isosurface Extraction is a fast GPU framework that extracts flat-shaded isosurfaces by replacing 3D volume tables with a 2D lookup table for boolean detection between front and back scalar values.
